title: Data of 8.7 million stolen
subtitle: Criminals publish data of 8.7 million people after hacking airports
excerpt: Criminals publish data of 8.7 million individuals
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The company that owns Manchester, Stansted and East Midlands airports was hacked last month.

Airports hacked

Following the cyber‑attack, the criminals released the data of 8.7 million people.

Cybersecurity is a constant concern for businesses and individuals, as cyber attacks can result in the loss of confidential and personal data.

  • Data protection is essential to prevent personal information from falling into criminals' hands.
  • Companies must invest in cybersecurity measures to prevent attacks.
  • Individuals should also take precautions to safeguard their personal information online.

It is important for both businesses and individuals to be aware of the risks of cyber attacks and to take steps to protect themselves.

With information from BBC News.
